title: afzelia scabra
intro: Afzelia scabra, commonly known as the Rajanaka or Rajanaka tree, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Afzelia scabra include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
